basic_details.job_title: AIFF Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 12 Manager, Deputy Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The All India Football Federation (AIFF) has invited applications for 12 posts in Delhi, from Manager, Finance and Accounts and Head of IT to Coordinator and Office Boy roles. Applications are accepted only through a separate Google Form for each post, and the last date is 21 November 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview, by email.

content_sections.heading: About AIFF
content_sections.text: The All India Football Federation (AIFF) is the organisation issuing this Recruitment Notice, and all 12 posts are located in Delhi. The notice describes its mission as promoting and developing football across India. The posts cover finance, legal, IT, women's football, administration, player registration, human resources, national teams and office support.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 12 posts. The number of vacancies for each post is not printed. Each post has its own Job Category, Area and Google Form.

rows.post: Deputy Manager, Player's, Status and Registration

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own qualification and experience, as printed in the notice. Age limit is not specified in the notice. Manager- Legal, Regulatory and Governance: strong knowledge of legal principles, regulatory frameworks and compliance processes; experience in drafting, reviewing and interpreting contracts; legal research and analysis; strong written and verbal communication; proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace; willingness and ability to travel domestically, as required. Head of IT: demonstrated experience in leading IT operations, managing large-scale IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications and digital transformation projects; proven experience in managing IT teams, technology vendors, budgets, contracts and strategic IT initiatives. Coordinator- Administration: good communication and organisational skills; proficiency in MS Office and email correspondence; ability to coordinate multiple tasks and work independently. Assistant Manager- Human Resources: strong knowledge of HR best practices, employment laws and regulations in India; ability to work in a multicultural environment; proficiency in HR software and Microsoft Office Suite. Coordinator- National teams: strong coordination, documentation and communication skills. Office Boy posts: basic communication skills (Admin) or basic reading, writing and communication skills (Accounts and Finance); punctual and disciplined; ability to follow instructions and work as part of a team. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: AIFF Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints a role overview and key responsibilities for most posts. The Deputy Manager and Manager posts in Player's Status and Registration have key responsibilities only. The Manager will manage and oversee the day-to-day accounting, finance, taxation, banking, payroll and statutory compliance functions of the Federation. Supervise day-to-day accounting operations; review and verify payment vouchers, journal entries and supporting documents; monitor accounts payable and general ledger. Handle direct and indirect taxation, including GST and Income Tax; ensure timely preparation and filing of TDS returns and other statutory returns. Manage day-to-day banking operations; supervise bank reconciliations; handle foreign payments, international remittances and related documentation, ensuring compliance with FEMA, RBI and banking regulations. Supervise monthly payroll processing and salary disbursement, including salaries, deductions, TDS and statutory contributions. Ensure timely reconciliation of bank accounts, ledger accounts, vendor accounts and other balances. Coordinate and facilitate statutory audits and internal audits; liaise with statutory auditors, internal auditors and tax auditors; monitor closure of audit objections. The Deputy Manager will manage the organisation's accounting, taxation, payroll, financial reporting, audit and compliance functions. Oversee day-to-day accounting, general ledger and books of accounts; manage monthly, quarterly and annual books closure; prepare and review Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Account and financial statements. Conduct budget versus actual analysis, variance analysis and financial MIS. Manage GST, TDS and Income Tax compliance; handle GST/TDS assessments, notices, appeals and departmental proceedings. Supervise monthly payroll, employee remuneration, incentives, reimbursements and deductions; coordinate with HR. Manage vendor payments, invoice verification, advances and expense settlements; monitor receivables, club billing and outstanding balances. Lead and coordinate Statutory Audit, Internal Audit, Event Audit, FIFA/AFC Audit and Forensic Audit. Oversee event-wise, tournament-wise and project-wise accounting, including utilisation reporting for FIFA Forward, AFC grants and other funded projects. The role overview in the notice describes the position as providing legal and regulatory support across relevant functions and helping maintain effective legal and regulatory frameworks. Administer, implement and periodically audit applicable regulations, operational policies, guidelines and statutory legal frameworks. Provide legal, regulatory and risk-management guidance to internal departments and external stakeholders; provide briefs and coordinate with external legal counsels. Draft, negotiate and review contracts, agreements, legal notices, official correspondence and binding instruments. Manage and resolve ongoing disputes, contractual claims, complaints and regulatory proceedings. Assist AIFF

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are advertised in AIFF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 12 posts, all in Delhi, including Manager, Deputy Manager, Head of IT, Assistant Manager, Coordinator and Office Boy positions. The number of vacancies for each post is not printed.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIFF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application deadline printed for every post is 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for AIFF jobs?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted only through the Google Form given for the post, sent in soft copy. Each of the 12 posts has its own Google Form link in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Manager, Finance and Accounts?
faq.answer: The notice requires M.com or MBA in Finance, minimum 15 years of relevant experience in Accounts and Finance, minimum 8 years in a sports federation or similar sports body, and hands-on SAP experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the Office Boy posts?
faq.answer: Both Office Boy- Admin and Office Boy- Accounts and Finance require a minimum of Class 10th pass. Experience of 1-5 years (Admin) or 1-2 years (Accounts and Finance) in office support is preferred.

faq.question: Q6. Which posts are open to graduates in any discipline?
faq.answer: Coordinator- Administration, Deputy Manager, Player's, Status and Registration, and Manager, Player's Status and Registration ask for a graduate degree in any discipline. Coordinator- National teams asks for a bachelor's degree in sports management or in any discipline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIFF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. The interview date and time will be communicated via email.

faq.question: Q8. Is residential work required for any AIFF post?
faq.answer: Yes, for Coordinator- National teams. The notice requires willingness to work full-time in a residential setup, with accommodation and meals provided by the NT.

faq.question: Q9. Does AIFF have to accept every application?
faq.answer: No. The notice says AIFF reserves the right to cancel/reject the vacancy or applications without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q10. What experience does the Head of IT post need?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a minimum of 15 years of relevant professional experience in IT management, infrastructure management, enterprise technology operations, or IT leadership roles.
